descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT 3.6 (cited by TC-11 ER 2) · “All windows are configuration values, not hard-coded, so they can be lengthened later under a hospital affiliation.”.

Decision D6 · S1 · Daniela

Transcript / retention windows differ from UAT 3.6 in ways no ticket AC settles: archive 48 h (not 36), 'Earlier sessions' and 'Most Recent' are undated, Quick Dictation boxes never expire, windows are hard-coded (make them configurable?); the Nursing Home course card shows the last 3 visits (UAT 3.6 says 2) (Q5)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-16/S23, TC-16/S27, OAT-04/S19, TC-04/S10, TC-11/S07

Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S28 Timeline windows come from the retention config, not hard-coded values

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 Retention windows are configuration values, not hard-coded (so they can be lengthened under a hospital affiliation); the Hospital timeline window follows from them. (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-11)
  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.6; TFA-92589 AC 4)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Main's code and UAT 3.6 ('All windows are configuration values, not hard-coded'; 'Course timeline … therefore show today and yesterday only')

When Read where the Hospital timeline window comes from (isRecentCourseLine in src/domain/courseTimeline.ts: today's and yesterday's labels) and the Nursing Home visit count (SHOW_LAST = 3 in src/features/snf/patient/panels/CoursePanel.tsx), and compare with the retention config (HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION in conve …

Then Both display windows derive from configured values, so lengthening retention under a hospital affiliation lengthens what the timeline shows

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Doc review by a developer, every finding quoted with file and line. A window that does not read the config is a finding against 3.6; it becomes a Fail or a pass once Q15 says whether the derived display must follow the config

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method CODEREVIEW · Code review; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-92589 ready for qa

The Hospital timeline's today/yesterday window and the Nursing Home last-3-visits are fixed in the app code. If retention were lengthened for a hospital affiliation, the timeline would still show the same entries.

Evidence: allure 2905f9b4, code review: isRecentCourseLine (src/domain/courseTimeline.ts:62-68) and CoursePanel.tsx:12 SHOW_LAST = 3. HOSPITAL_RETENTION and SNF_RETENTION in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts are module-private and used only by the purge. Pass or fail depends on TC-11 Q15: must the display windows follow the retention config (UAT 3.6)?

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: CODEREVIEW · Code review; secondary: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
